AC amendment (gap analysis #7 - state_file_conflict): Preserve BOTH null-case branches. The new null-case guard is on blue_team_accepted.findings (POST-filter); the EXISTING Step 2 zero-finding skip on red_team findings (PRE-filter) MUST remain intact. Naive dd-4 implementation may delete the existing branch.
Verify (both must match):
  grep -q 'Red team found no cross-story gaps' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/prompts/phase-e-adversarial-review.md
  AND grep -qE 'blue_team_accepted\.findings.*(empty|zero|null)|empty.*blue_team_accepted' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/prompts/phase-e-adversarial-review.md
Case (a) red-team-zero skips ALL of Steps 2-4; case (b) blue-team-rejected-all only skips the new re-dispatch but still proceeds through Step 4 artifact write.
